@@U03462@@
But you saw it! That violence! Here! Now! Raging plutonic fire, monstrous bursts of Aeolian gases breaking through the ancient crust of the level earth, so that instantly a mountain came into being!

@@U03464@@
And what is that meant to prove? If it’s here, it’s here, and perhaps that’s all to the good. Arguments like this are a waste of time; they lead people around by the nose, if they don’t watch out.

@@U03466@@
Look there! Every rock and cleft is already aswarm with myrmidons searching out a home: ants and 俾格米侏儒们 and tiny Tom Thumbs, and a host of other busy little bodies.

@@U03467@@
(To 荷蒙库鲁斯.)

@@U03468@@
You've never aspired to great deeds, you've lived in quiet, hermitlike confinement— so if you can adapt yourself to governing, I'll see to it they crown you king of the mountain.

@@U03470@@
What does my 泰勒斯 say?

@@U03472@@
He says don’t do it. Little folk give rise to little deeds; but with the great, little folk can rise to greatness.
translation:
@@U03462@@
但你看到了！那种暴力！这里！现在！熊熊的冥火，滔天的风气冲破了古老的地壳，瞬间一座山峰诞生了！

@@U03464@@
那是想证明什么呢？如果它在这里，它就在这里，也许这就是好事。像这样的争论是浪费时间；如果人们不小心的话，他们就会牵着人们的鼻子走。

@@U03466@@
看那儿！每块岩石和裂缝都挤满了正在寻找家园的小虫：蚂蚁、俾格米侏儒、小拇指汤姆，以及许多其他忙碌的小身体。

@@U03467@@
（致荷蒙库鲁斯。）

@@U03468@@
你从来没有渴望过伟大的事迹，你一直生活在安静、隐士般的禁闭中——所以如果你能适应统治，我会帮助他们加冕你为山王。

@@U03470@@
我的泰勒斯说什么？

@@U03472@@
他说不要这样做。小人成就小事；但有了伟人，小人物也能成为伟人。
